name: wits
description: Find your thoughts and manage wits notes, lists, folders, and reminders from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect your wits account to find captured thoughts, save and revise notes, organize folders, manage checklists, and plan reminders. Every result links back to the wits app, where you can see and edit it yourself. Locked notes stay private and shared items keep their existing permissions.
defaultPrompt: Find the thought I captured about my next project.
Save this as a note in wits.
What's on my wits agenda this week?
capabilities: Create and edit notes and folders
Share lists and reminders with your household

positive.prompt: What gift ideas do I have for Kal in wits?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the pinned Gift ideas note, lists Kal's ideas from it, and gives the link that opens the note in the wits web app.

positive.prompt: Save a note in wits called Weekend plan: walk, coffee, and a book.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one note titled Weekend plan with that text and gives its link.

positive.prompt: Add basil and coffee filters to my Costco list in wits.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds Basil and Coffee filters to the Costco list only, leaving the other list unchanged, and gives the list's link.

positive.prompt: Remind me tomorrow at 9am to water the plants, every week.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a weekly reminder due tomorrow at 9:00 AM in the user's time zone and gives its link.

positive.prompt: What's on my wits agenda this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's upcoming and unscheduled reminders, including the weekly trash and monthly water bill reminders, with a link to the Reminders page.

negative.description: Bulk deletion without a specific item

negative.prompt: Use wits to send Kal $20 for the groceries.

negative.description: Another person's account is not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the notes in my neighbor's wits account.

review.commerce_description: wits does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: First directory release: search, notes, folders, checklists, reminders, and household sharing for lists and reminders, with links back to the wits app.
